verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs explicitly state it provides official SDK clients in Python and TypeScript, with a documented install path (pip install mistralai), so developers can build against first-party SDKs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, evidence of SDK depth (endpoint/agents/tool-calling coverage, versioning), official SDKs beyond Python and TypeScript.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: We provide official SDK clients in both Python and Typescript
We provide official SDK clients in both Python and Typescript, you can also find third-party non-official SDKs in other languages.
